answer: Trust the check, not the claimant: Plasterer skim trial lodged with the plasterers warrant is the check, and it reads 3-year apprenticeship, 146 supervised skims, guild exam, 79 POA annual fee, renewal. The farm's budget must cover 754 proofs at 119 POA each — 89726 POA — before any reward is even possible. Judge it by the shale: open, checkable, and older than the reward. Judge it by the island: real money, real time, gone before any payout. Judge it by the echo: a file that outlives the farm. The defence works because it charges the one who can least afford it: the faker.
